// Baseline capture: exact `int` arithmetic through the numeric V1 syscalls, with entrypoint
// arguments so nothing is folded at compile time.
seiyaku BaselineNumeric {
  view fn add(int a, int b) authorize(anyone) -> int {
    return a + b;
  }
  view fn sub(int a, int b) authorize(anyone) -> int {
    return a - b;
  }
  view fn mul(int a, int b) authorize(anyone) -> int {
    return a * b;
  }
  view fn div(int a, int b) authorize(anyone) -> int {
    return a / b;
  }
  view fn rem(int a, int b) authorize(anyone) -> int {
    return a % b;
  }
  view fn less(int a, int b) authorize(anyone) -> bool {
    return a < b;
  }
}
